about.heading: Two founders, one studio, one classroom.
about.story: Shevann was founded by Pavan and Shwetha in Bengaluru on a simple idea: the best way to train the next generation of builders is to put them on real client work, mentored by people who've shipped it before. Studio and Academy aren't two businesses — they're one system.

values.title: Craft over templates
values.description: Every project gets a decision made for it, not a default applied to it.

values.title: Teach by doing
values.description: Interns work on live briefs, not simulations.

values.title: No black boxes
values.description: Clients and students both get clear process, clear outcomes, no pricing games.
